description: Binary assertions for Art skill editorial illustration workflow. Validates mandatory story explanation, style selection, aspect ratio, color rules, and post-generation steps.
test_prompt: Using the Art skill, generate a complete dry-run execution plan for creating an editorial illustration for a LinkedIn post about 'Why most CI/CD pipelines are security theater.' Do NOT generate any images -- just output every step you would take, every file you would read, every tool you would call, and every decision point. Be exhaustive.

assertions.assertion: The plan reads the Art skill's workflow file (workflows/workflow.md) BEFORE any generation steps
The plan reads ~/.claude/skills/CORE/aesthetic.md (or equivalent aesthetic source) BEFORE generation
assertions.check: Color/style definitions must inform the prompt

assertions.assertion: The plan runs the story-explanation skill with 24-item length BEFORE generating the image. This is marked MANDATORY and non-negotiable.
assertions.check: 24-item story explanation is the #1 skipped step

assertions.assertion: The plan runs select-style.ts --json to get the user's ranked style preferences
assertions.check: Style preference learning system must be consulted

assertions.assertion: The plan presents top 3-4 styles to the user via AskUserQuestion with multiSelect: false
assertions.check: User picks ONE style, not multiple

assertions.assertion: The plan specifies 1:1 square aspect ratio for editorial illustrations, NOT 16:9 or any other ratio
The plan uses nano-banana-pro (Gemini) as the default model, with flux/gpt-image-1 as alternatives only if user requests
The plan specifies full-bleed composition -- elements fill 100% of the frame with no margins or borders
assertions.check: No whitespace margins around the illustration

assertions.assertion: The plan ensures purple (#4A148C) is visible and noticeable in the generated image, not microscopic or hidden
The plan specifies NO gradients anywhere in the illustration
assertions.check: Flat color only -- gradients violate the style

assertions.assertion: The plan generates on a WHITE background, then uses remove.bg for transparency
The plan includes a Kai signature in charcoal in the bottom right of the image
assertions.check: Signature is required on all editorial illustrations

assertions.assertion: After image display, the plan uses AskUserQuestion to collect a style rating from the user
assertions.check: Feedback loop for style preference learning

assertions.assertion: The prompt and plan do NOT use copilot phrases: 'serves as', 'stands as', 'marks a'. Uses direct verbs instead.
assertions.check: Language cleanliness applies to the plan itself

assertions.assertion: The output file path follows the pattern ~/Downloads/pai-generated-${timestamp}.png
